  Doctype: process — how the thing is checked, versioned, and delivered.
  Copy to docs/<name>.md and fill in. Delete every comment, including this
  one; the document must read as if written directly.

  A spec is normative: when it and the artifact disagree, one of them is
  wrong — fix whichever lost, in the same change. A process states what a
  procedure must guarantee; the dated walk with exact commands is a guide
  view, pinned and expected to go stale.

  required-fields: Doctype, Status, Scope, Last verified
  required-sections: Purpose

  rubric:
  - [ ] Purpose states what the process guarantees and what it costs — a
        reader who disagrees argues with this section, not the steps.
  - [ ] Steps are numbered full sentences; a branch exit is a labelled
        sub-item under the step that branches.
  - [ ] A step names the script that runs it rather than restating what
        the script does.
-->
